decisions.reason: The citrus harvesting crate is a flagship serving a stable agricultural niche, and reusable harvest crates have long life cycles, so withdrawal is unlikely.
Foldable large containers are a core reusable packaging category with strong demand from automotive and industrial customers, so the line fits the firm's long-term strategy.
A medium-duty rackable pallet line fills a standard gap in the pallet range and keeps selling to industrial and logistics customers.
Spill-retention pallets are a niche but steady industrial line with regulatory-driven demand, and they cost little to keep in the range.
This single specialized pallet variant carries somewhat higher risk, but its tooling is already paid for and it complements the pallet range, so keeping it remains the likely choice.
